title: The Most Desperate Attempt to Avoid Jail
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 23, 2022, an officer was surveilling a residence for a possible female suspect in La Crosse, WI. She was on bond for one felony and five misdemeanors, as well as having multiple active warrants. The officer followed her vehicle as she left the residence. She eventually abandoned her car and fled on foot, only to be apprehended quickly. Once she realized her fate, she pretended to experience a medical complication to avoid being sent to jail.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
